name: 28791 · Hendersonvlle, NC
findings: ZIP 28791 (Hendersonvlle) has 35 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (60%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28791 (Hendersonvlle) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
